repairs.cause: The search did return results (Liechtenstein POIs, ranked ~5808 mi away because the map is not centered near Liechtenstein), but the program blocked waiting for an 'INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS' button that never appears on this screen and then wrongly raised "no search result found". Also, the full-string query "Malbun, Liechtenstein" matched POI names containing "Liechtenstein" instead of the village Malbun itself.

The searches for "Nendeln, Liechtenstein"/"Nendeln" never produced a selected result, and the "Add marker" action was never executed; the final clicks dismissed the search/context menu, leaving a bare map with no marker, so the oracle rejected it.

The search for "Malbun" returned no results ("Could not find anything: 5 mi") because the device has no internet (status bar shows "No internet") and the offline map data doesn't cover Malbun/Liechtenstein; the agent only scrolled and re-pressed enter instead of widening the search or restoring connectivity.

The run only typed the search query and tapped around the results list, but never opened the Nendeln result and used the context-menu "Add marker" (marker flag) action, so no marker was actually created and the oracle rejected it.

The search for "Malbun" completed but returned no results within the 5-mile radius ("Could not find anything: 5 mi"), likely because the offline map data for Liechtenstein isn't downloaded or the radius is too small; the agent looped retrying the same search instead of expanding the radius.
